Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Thank you for your message; our team will provide the requested cost breakdown separately. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are prepared to revise our offer to EUR 370.60 per unit under the current terms. Specifically, our Angebot stands at a price of €370.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your updated proposal. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response, we have adjusted our offer to EUR 370.15 per unit. 

According to our pricing guidelines, our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. For this revised offer, the terms are a price of €370.15 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this clarifies our position and look forward to your feedback on this revised proposal.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
